Thermal-conductivity coefficients a..i are (11314.56,-30824.32,34964.24,-21141.43,7187.43,-1302.708,98.35252,0,0) for density 20.02 kg/m3 air-fill gas (data/equation 100-300/90-300 K; fit error 1.5 percent), and (-4123.51,9690.59,-7920.09,1572.897,1459.993,-1028.329,255.773,-23.31925,0) for density 56.06 kg/m3 CO2-blown material (125-300/100-300 K; fit error 2 percent). Specific-heat coefficients are (190.776,-991.521,2200.811,-2726.414,2069.971,-988.4221,290.405,-48.0737,3.437928) for density 48.05 kg/m3 material (10-300 K; fit error 2 percent). Source-fill-gas code is 1 for air, 2 for CO2, and 0 when NIST does not report a gas for the specific-heat curve; density and code are retained as per-claim validity axes to prevent ambiguous same-key lookup. The 300 K point evaluations below use those published coefficients and have validity restricted to exactly 300 K; fit-error notes are retained but are not promoted to statistical uncertainty or an interpolation guarantee. This is low-density foam data, not a generic bulk PVC solid.
